question: SPEC-0336 (remote gate worker, first slice of the remote-workers epic) hit its cost cap a second time: $32.14 spent of $40. Review is 87/90; only minor findings remain. How do we proceed?

Waive the remaining minor findings and send it to close now (nothing more spent on fixes)

facts: review score 87/90, remaining findings are minor/nit (cancel-write timeout, pre-slot signal, have() traceback, info.git_sha)
cap already raised once 30->40; 3 of 4 implement loops used; profile cap max would be 60

answer.label: Waive the remaining minor findings and send it to close now (nothing more spent on fixes)
